additional_info.subject: RE: 0382607 - ID0382607-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / PN 312562229/05] cable is starting to be damaged, and it may disattached from plug CRM:02023000176
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-FR Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE VIANEO
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / PN 312562229/05
Charger ID/Serial No.:
mtdGiB
Problem Description:
cable is starting to be damaged, and it may disattached from plug
we recommend you replace the cable,
please be informed that
warranty decision lies with warranty claim manager
.
Kindly carry the cable from below list, which is relevant to you.
However,
before proceeding for replacement we need below information from you.
This information should include:
Defective part name/MLFB
Component serial number
Outcome of wiring checkup
Commissioning checklist
Commissioning date
Field service report
Date of failure
CCS Cables
CP-to-ground Voltage reading (standby)
Signs of corrosion (external)
Evidence of water ingress
Outlet Number and position (e.g. DC1 - Left)
Cable lifetime from commissioning until replacement
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [
2/18/2024]
,
as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
